description: The spinning disc formation on Day 13. A spiral of Kaurava units with a single entry point at the outer ring and NO exit. Abhimanyu (PANDAVA) spawns at tile (12,0).

tiles.note: Drona stands here. Defeating him would break the formation — but Dharma locks him as the formation's heart.

tile_overrides.note: The ONLY entry tile. Requires chakravyuha-enterer trait to pass. All other perimeter tiles block non-Kaurava units.
Once passed into the ring, exit is closed. The formation seals behind Abhimanyu.

perimeter_impassable_rule: All tiles at x_min=0, x_max=24, y_min=0, y_max=24 perimeter except tile (12,0) are impassable for all PANDAVA units except those with chakravyuha-enterer trait.

PANDAVA.note: Abhimanyu alone enters. Pandava allies cannot follow.

ring_1.description: Infantry ring, outer radius ~11 tiles from center

rotation_mechanic.effect: All unit placements shift clockwise by 1 step per turn, making paths unpredictable.

directive_notes.note: Abhimanyu dying IS canonical progression. Surviving all 15 turns unlocks a hidden 'What-If' branch.
